Bill.BriefDescription: Expanding export assistance to businesses throughout the state.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expanding export assistance statewide; adding anew section to chapter 43.210 RCW; repealing RCW 43.210.050; and makingan appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.210 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The small business export finance assistance center shall developa rural manufacturer export outreach program in collaboration withWashington manufacturing services. The program must provide outreachservices to rural manufacturing businesses in Washington to inform themof the importance of, and opportunities in, international trade, and toinform them of the export assistance programs available to assist thesebusinesses to become exporters.

The sum of fifty thousand dollars, or asmuch thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal yearending June 30, 2008, from the general fund to the small businessexport finance assistance center, created under RCW 43.210.020, for thepurposes of section 1 of this act.
RCW 43.210.050 (Export assistance servicescontract with department of community, trade, and economic development)and 1998 c 245 s 84, 1995 c 399 s 107, & 1991 c 314 s 16 are eachrepealed.
